messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Hey team — StratusChip sent the final draft of the joint case study and the illustrator-exported hero asset. Need quick QA before we send to legal. Attach: https://files.redwood.co/stratuschip/hero_v1.png
Tom (Design): Link works. Quick visual notes: hero has chip render on white bg, partner logo too close to our lockup. Recommend 16px clearspace and drop shadow removed.
Jess (Brand): Agree with Tom. Also partner provided a horizontal logo variant but it's low res — request SVG.
Maya (Partnerships): Got it. Maya -> @StratusChip asking for SVG and updated hero. Could someone confirm quote permission? We used a customer quote in section 2.
Legal-Ops: We have verbal ok from the customer but need signed release. Please add TODO in workflows and cc legal@redwood.com.
Tom (Design): Small color mismatch: partner blue doesn't match their hex in guidelines. They used #0A74FF vs guideline #0A7BFF. Should we nudge partner?
Jess (Brand): Yes ask them to match brand book. Also their logo uses a badge treatment not in guidelines — need clarification whether allowed in co-brand.
Maya (Partnerships): Draft message to partner:

```text
Hi StratusChip — thanks for the assets. Quick asks: 1) Can you send SVG of horizontal lockup? 2) Please confirm the hero uses your official blue (#0A7BFF). 3) We need signed customer quote release from AcmeCorp (cc legal). 4) Update partner badge to approved lockup or confirm exception.
Thanks — Maya, Redwood Partnerships
```

Tom (Design): LGTM
Jess (Brand): LGTM, add alt-text for accessibility: 'StratusChip silicon module mounted on server motherboard'.
Maya (Partnerships): Sent message to partner @stratuschip — flagged as high priority. Forwarding their reply here when it comes in.
Brand-Bot: Reminder: asset checklist required for marketplace listing — logos, alt-text, SVGs, 2 social tiles, approved quote.
StratusChip Rep: Thanks Maya, we'll get SVG and signed release by EOD Friday. Regarding blue — our designer committed a typo, we'll update. Sharing new hero in 24h :thumbsup:
Jess (Brand): Great — once we have SVG + release, I'll do final lockup pass. Can someone schedule a 15m sync if they don't deliver by Thursday?
Maya (Partnerships): I'll schedule a quick sync for Thurs 10am as backup.
Tom (Design): I'll add notes to the Figma file and set an approval comment.
Legal-Ops: Please add the release into doc tracker: `legal/releases/stratuschip_acmecorp` and tag us.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. If StratusChip slips, escalate to partner PM.
